steps.say: The quadrant boundaries are the multiples of 90°, because each quadrant is a quarter-turn: quadrant 1 runs from 0° to 90°, quadrant 2 from 90° to 180°, quadrant 3 from 180° to 270°, and quadrant 4 from 270° to 360°.
The angle [[angle]]° falls between two of those boundaries, and that interval is quadrant [[value]].

answer: So the terminal side lies in quadrant [[value]].
